name: Hirschberg splits b at the smallest column that maximises forward + backward
why: ab and ba share two LCSs of length 1, a and b. a splits at mid = 1 into a | b. forward(a vs b prefixes) = [0,0,1], backward(b vs b suffixes) = [1,0,0]; sums [1,0,1]; the smallest maximising column is 0, so a gets the empty prefix of b and b is matched inside ba. Result b.
